question:

The candidate regions below are normalized [x1, y1, x2, y2] with values in [0, 1] (origin at the top-left corner). Which region contains the real difference?
(A) [0.1378, 0.7570, 0.2778, 0.8970]
(B) [0.2782, 0.0682, 0.4182, 0.2082]
(C) [0.6253, 0.5820, 0.7653, 0.7220]
(D) The two figures show no real difference, only compression noise.

Answer with only the correct option letter.
